description.content:
Returns a pre-signed download URL for a specific Global Payroll (GP) employee payslip PDF. Use this after calling Retrieve employee payslips to obtain the payslipId. Requires the worker id (UUID) and the payslipId from the list response. The returned URL is temporary and should be used promptly to download the file. Supports only GP contract types.
 **Token scopes**: `payslips:read`

header.description:
(Required) ## Authentication
The Deel API uses bearer tokens to authenticate requests. All API calls must be made over HTTPS — calls over plain HTTP or without authentication will fail.

```curl
curl -X GET 'https://api.letsdeel.com/rest/v2/contracts' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR-TOKEN-HERE'
```

[Learn more about authentication](/api/authentication)

description.content:
Retrieves GP workers additional information fields that are required for running payroll depending on the country regulations
 **Token scopes**: `forms:read`

variable.description: (Required) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for which to retrieve GP worker additional fields.
